title: 6 tips for Twitter customer support | Freshworks Academy
description: Social media customer support is a boon and a bane. We are wired to pay more attention to negative news than the positive ones. That’s why, as a brand, it’s very important to get something as public as social media customer support right.  There are no hard and fast rules on how you should approach social media support, but there are certainly ways to get better at it and keep evolving.   Read the related blog post: http://bit.ly/2FifTKZ  6 Tips to Handle Customer Support on Twitter:   ▢ Respond quickly   ▢ Set the right expectations  ▢ Give a personal touch to your replies  ▢ Turn negative feedback around in your favor  ▢ Segment the support and marketing handles  ▢ Anticipate issues and reach out proactively  To know how to deliver stellar customer support on Facebook, check out: https://freshdesk.com/customer-service-training/tips-facebook-support-blog/  Join the Freshworks Academy to see real-life examples of great customer support on Twitter - https://www.freshworks.com/academy  Check out Freshworks, a refreshingly simple customer engagement software that your teams will love: https://www.freshworks.com

asr.full_text: What is the most heartwarming social media support story you remember? You can probably recall one story that went viral recently. Now, what is the most disastrous social media support story you remember? You're probably remembering one big social media disaster, many average goof-ups, and maybe a few that happened to you personally. We are wired to pay more attention to the negative news than the positive ones. That's why, as a brand, it's very important to get something as public as social media support right. There are no hard and fast rules on how you should approach social media support, but there are certainly ways you could get better at it and keep evolving. Hey there, I'm Akshaya from the FreshTisk academy and today we are going to learn how to handle twitter customer support like a pro. Respond quickly. 60% of the customers who reach out to brands on twitter expect a reply in one hour. One way to make sure you reply quickly on twitter is by hiring more people or by assigning a dedicated support rep for twitter. Another way of doing this is by hiring more people or by assigning a dedicated support rep for Twitter. Another way of doing this is by prioritizing. You can use dedicated tools like Freshdesk that help you cancel out all the noise in marketing interactions and direct your attention to customers who need help. Set the right expectations. It's important to let your customers know that you are not ignoring the tweets on purpose by setting the right expectations. Twitter has a bunch of features that let you specify your business hours and also the times during which your handle is most responsive. Twitter even goes one step ahead and lets businesses greet users automatically every time they enter a direct message conversation. This way, you're accessible even if you're not available. Give a personal touch to your replies. The most loved brands on Twitter have a unique personality. They go beyond simply resolving issues to actually connecting with the customers. Simple things like making the brand replies humorous or mentioning the names of the support agents in every tweet helps show that there are real people behind the brand. Twitter has a feature that shows the support agent's name and picture every time a customer sends a direct message. This makes sure the customers feel at ease before sharing their problems. Turn negative feedback around in your favor. No brand is immune to the occasional bug or goof-up that'll anger the customers. The first thing to do when handling social media crisis is to not ignore it. Deal with these angry customers with care and empathy. Own up to your mistakes and apologise. Promise that you'll look deeper into the issue and do so. If the customers feel that the comments are being heard and acted upon, they will calm down. They might even spread the word about the positive experience! Segment the support and marketing handles For bigger brands, it makes more sense to have an exclusive support handle apart from the primary handle. This way you can maintain a separate style and language for your marketing campaigns without affecting how your support queries are dealt with. You can also use the support handle to post service and maintenance updates. This setup would be preferred by customers too as no one likes being bombarded with a lot of marketing messages when more serious concerns are at hand. Anticipate issues and reach out proactively keep an eye on what customers are saying about you and reach out to them proactively even before they need help this kind of proactive approach involves getting a social media monitoring tool that monitors the mentions and keywords relevant to your product or industry proactive support surprises and delights the customers and helps them understand that you genuinely care about them. Follow these 6 tips to create a Unique Twitter Strategy to win customers over What are some strategies that you use to support customers effectively on Twitter? Let us know in the comments section.
